recap.say: `def name():` plus an indented body makes a command. `name()` runs it.

fetch_gem: Compare your result with the Goal view: home again, facing east.
Turning around is two left turns. Give it a name with `def turn_around():`.

def turn_right():
    turn_left()
    turn_left()
    turn_left()


def turn_around():

def go_to_gem():
    move()
    turn_right()
    move()
    turn_left()
    move()
    move()


def come_home():
    turn_around()
    __


go_to_gem()

come_home()
